subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) Everyday he used to go fishing early in the morning. (b) Once upon a time there lived a fisherman who was old and poor. (c) But he never threw his net into the sea more than four times. (d) One morning the threw his net into the sea as usual. (e) He thought he had caught a large fish and so he felt very happy. (f) But a moment later he saw that he had no fish rather only a dead donkey. (g) He could barely support his wife and three children. (h) He was very disappointed.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
